name: OpenEMR prior to 5.0.1.4 OS Command Injection via hylafax_server
description: OS command injection in OpenEMR before 5.0.1.4 allows a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary commands by changing the hylafax_server global setting and triggering daemon_frame.php.
author: AMENDER / Rezwanul Haque
_notes: This is OS command injection via hylafax_server global setting, not file upload RCE. The PoC injects commands by modifying form_284 in edit_globals.php then triggering daemon_frame.php.
